src: 'The Withered Bloom'

src: 'Thunderhawk'

src: 'The Storm Herald'

k: Vesper Knight
src: 'Vesper Knight'

src: 'Dawnguard Elite'

k: The last of Garrick's men. They stayed because he stayed.
src: 'The last of Garrick\'s men. They stayed because he stayed.'

src: 'They sing the Vespersong in rounds, to keep the moment warm.'

k: Bell Golem
src: 'Bell Golem'

src: 'A bell from the City of Bells, given legs and told to toll for the end of time.'

k: Captain Ivo Brask
src: 'Captain Ivo Brask'

src: 'Garrick\'s second. He has polished the same breastplate every morning for a year, because no one told him to stop.'

k: Lord-Commander Garrick
src: 'Lord-Commander Garrick'

src: 'Head of the Dawnguard and Cassian\'s sword. He has seen the world broken, and would rather it frozen.'

k: Garrick Thorne
src: 'Garrick Thorne'

src: 'No title now. No soldiers. Just a man with a sword, and another man with a sword.'

k: He is bleeding. So is Bram. Neither of them is sitting down.
src: 'He is bleeding. So is Bram. Neither of them is sitting down.'

k: Drowned Memory
src: 'Drowned Memory'

k: Something that happened here, once, on an ordinary day. It wants to happen again.
src: 'Something that happened here, once, on an ordinary day. It wants to happen again.'

k: Gull Wraith
src: 'Gull Wraith'

src: 'Lanternfall\'s gulls were always bold. They are bolder dead.'

src: 'Tidewrack Horror'

k: Everything the sea took from Lanternfall, wound together and come home.
src: 'Everything the sea took from Lanternfall, wound together and come home.'

k: Lamplit Moth
src: 'Lamplit Moth'

src: 'It has circled the Lantern for a year. It has never once thought of leaving.'

src: 'Hound of the Black Rocks'

src: 'You fought it on the night Sable washed ashore. It remembers you. You were so much smaller.'

k: Kept Light
src: 'Kept Light'

k: A little of the light she could not let go of.
src: 'A little of the light she could not let go of.'

src: 'The Keeper\'s Remnant'

k: Ysolde Halloway, Keeper of Lanternfall, still holding the last light so her daughter can reach the boat.
src: 'Ysolde Halloway, Keeper of Lanternfall, still holding the last light so her daughter can reach the boat.'

k: Abyss Crab
src: 'Abyss Crab'

src: 'It walked the sea floor its whole life. The floor is in the sky now. It keeps walking.'

k: Sky Jelly
src: 'Sky Jelly'

k: It drifts above the reef, pulsing like a slow heart.
src: 'It drifts above the reef, pulsing like a slow heart.'

k: Wreck Eel
src: 'Wreck Eel'

k: It nests in the ribs of drowned ships.
src: 'It nests in the ribs of drowned ships.'

src: 'The Undertow'

src: 'The storm that took Edrin Halloway, remembered by the sea it happened in.'

src: 'Fever Wraith'

src: 'Clean sheets. Folded corners. Something still lying in them.'

src: 'The Matron of Ash'

src: 'Every long night on every ward, given a voice. It sounds exactly like Ilse on her worst day.'

src: 'Vigil Knight'

src: 'Every knight who ever stood the vigil here left a little of themselves in the stone. It stands up to see if you are worthy.'

src: 'Squire\'s Shade'

src: 'The squires who failed the vigil. They are not angry. Only cold.'

src: 'Scrap Golem'

src: 'Junk Mimic'

src: 'It is a crate. It is a crate with teeth. Do not open the crate with teeth.'

k: Scrap Rook
src: 'Scrap Rook'

k: It steals buttons, rings, buckles and, given the chance, eyes.
src: 'It steals buttons, rings, buckles and, given the chance, eyes.'

k: The Rook Queen
src: 'The Rook Queen'

src: 'Queen of Scrapfall, the best thief in the sky. Until about five minutes ago.'

k: The Squall King
src: 'The Squall King'

k: Kingfisher Gunner
src: 'Kingfisher Gunner'

src: 'The Kingfisher\'s crew never left their guns. Nobody told them the battle was over.'

src: 'The Forgotten'

src: 'Someone nobody remembers anymore. It does not remember either.'

src: 'Gloam Shade'

src: 'The Gloam, when it tries to be someone.'

src: 'The Unremembered'

src: 'Every forgotten thing the Gloam ever kept, wanting one more thing to keep.'

src: 'The Fallen Star'

src: 'A star that came too close, to see what all the fuss was about.'

src: 'The Choir opens a hundred mouths. Other voices answer from the glass.'

src: '"I can hear your heart, little thief. It is beating much too fast."'

k: The Choir draws one long breath together...
src: 'The Choir draws one long breath together...'

k: "Hush now. Listen."
src: '"Hush now. Listen."'

k: Frost climbs his robes like a second skin.
src: 'Frost climbs his robes like a second skin.'

k: "I should have said it the first day. Four words. _This fork is wrong._"
src: '"I should have said it the first day. Four words. _This fork is wrong._"'

src: 'The air goes still. Even your heartbeat waits its turn.'

k: "Where are my little ones? Come back to Mother!"
src: '"Where are my little ones? Come back to Mother!"'

src: '"Hush, hush. Mother\'s here. Nobody dies in Mirefen."'

k: She draws her brood close, and swells.
src: 'She draws her brood close, and swells.'

k: The petals turn toward you, slowly, like a face toward the sun.
src: 'The petals turn toward you, slowly, like a face toward the sun.'

k: "Sleep, children. I remember summers that lasted a hundred years."
src: '"Sleep, children. I remember summers that lasted a hundred years."'

k: "HEAR ME! THE NOON IS COMING!" The storm breaks over you.
src: '"HEAR ME! THE NOON IS COMING!" The storm breaks over you.'
